evidence: Three engineering stress bundles, not probability distributions. Future recurring production costs and delivery surcharges are assumptions, not vendor quotations. Published concepts anchor scale and performance bounds; they do not validate this programme. Fixed development, detailed installation and full network recoupling remain separate.
boundary: Lunar surface electricity for the enclosed off-Earth programme served by U. No atmospheric heat penalty, shield credit or habitat array. Existing remote source and depot supplies remain outside this substitution.
accounting: Compare identical mean electrical service and firm capacity. Common load heat, ordinary local distribution and the existing 72-hour critical reserve are retained outside the incremental supply comparison. Night-cycle storage is additional. Water is one conserved inventory, not a recurring fuel burn. All equipment receives an explicit replacement life. Cost includes recurring production and delivery of hardware; option-specific qualification and site civil works remain unpriced. Solar thermal storage media are always procured locally as bulk material; media inventory remains through plant renewals, while containment and conversion hardware are renewed. Media costs and retention are explicit engineering assumptions.

daytime_productive_pilot.reading_rule: Different service from the continuous comparisons: daylight-only output at an ordinary site. Survival heaters, short buffers and night standby must be added for actual equipment.
